GS details new SEC requirements for institutional investment managers to report monthly short position data starting in January 2025. Similarly, MS identifies its subsidiary MSSB as a registered investment adviser with the SEC, subject to fiduciary obligations, and notes that the SEC has broad powers to restrict MSSB's activities for non-compliance. While GS focuses on a specific new data reporting mandate, MS focuses on the foundational registration and supervisory powers over its advisory business; both confirm active, direct regulatory compliance responsibilities with the SEC in the asset management space.

sentences.text: The SEC requires certain institutional investment managers that meet or exceed certain specified reporting thresholds to report on a monthly basis specific short position data and short activity data for equity securities.
Reporting under this rule was required beginning in January 2025.
MSSB is also a registered investment adviser with the SEC.

The SEC and other supervisory bodies generally have broad administrative powers to address non-compliance, including the power to restrict or limit MSSB from carrying on its investment advisory and other asset management activities.
